examples.problem: Find the value of the vector function $\mathbf f(t) = \left\langle \cos t, \: \sin t, \: t \right\rangle$ at $t = \pi.$
examples.worked_solution:
To evaluate, we substitute $t = \pi$ into the function, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}f(\pi ) & =⟨\operatorname{cos}⁡\pi ,\,\operatorname{sin}⁡\pi ,\,\pi ⟩=⟨-1,0,\pi \,⟩\end{aligned}
$$

So, the value of $\mathbf f (t)$ at $t = \pi$ is $\langle -1, 0, \pi \rangle.$

We can also express the answer using $\mathbf i$-$\mathbf j$-$\mathbf k$ notation or square bracket notation, as follows:

$$
[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 0 \\ \pi \end{aligned}]
$$
